description: Rigid body physics of the system from its @Joint (on interface or port definitions), @Support and @LoadCase metadata. Statics: for each joint and load case the force and moment it carries, checked against its stated capacities (verdict and margin), where a hinge comes to rest (hanging or on a stop), and parts with no load path to the supported structure. With motion_s: that many seconds of motion under one load case (how far each moving group travels and turns, where each joint ends).

load_case.description: One load case by name (default: all for statics, the first for motion).

motion_s.description: Also step the motion for this many simulated seconds.

root.description: The top level part usage to elaborate (default: the last one, the configured system).

text.description: The complete SysML v2 model text. The server keeps no state: pass the whole current text on every call, and after an edit use the text the edit returned.

name: physics
title: Joint loads and rigid body motion
